name: Denmark

observations.reasoning: Sourced on 2026-07-27, transversal pass over the population indicator. Population on 1 January 2025: 5992734 inhabitants, recorded as 5.993 million. Eurostat dataset demo_pjan, Population on 1 January by age and sex, read through the dissemination API on 2026-07-27, dataset last updated 2026-07-09. Total population, both sexes, all ages, which is exactly what this indicator's denominator asks for. Read as one table covering every country in the record, so no value here is derived from a neighbour: each is that country's own row. The previous value was an opening estimate produced with no source and no research.

Collected on 2026-07-28, in Danish, in the transversal venues pass. Two units, one house and one stage, against an opening estimate of 1.5 produced with no research. Teater Refleksion works at Jyllandsgaarden, Frederiksgade 72b in Aarhus, and was founded in 1990 by Bjarne Sandborg with, in its own account, the dream of making a children's theatre specialising in puppet and animation theatre; it has built twenty-five years of craft in that form and plays without words. Aarhus Kommune counts it among the children's theatres it funds and granted it 1.2 million kroner of bridge financing to hold its place in the city's cultural life until its move to Gellerup. The address recorded is the present one and the move is known to be coming. The stage is the Marionetteatret in Kronprinsessegade, at the edge of the Kongens Have, founded in 1966 and, since the death of Birthe Norst, run in one organisation with Det Lille Teater in Lavendelstræde. The two divide the year — Det Lille Teater from September to May, the Marionetteatret from June to September — and together they are a lille storbyteater of the City of Copenhagen, carrying an operating grant of 4.5 million kroner a year for 2021 to 2024, reduced from 5.1 when the scheme was widened. The små storbyteatre are municipally financed with a state contribution, which makes the backing here as explicit as anywhere in the record. Only the Marionetteatret is counted: Det Lille Teater is a children's theatre and the puppetry is the other half of the house, which is a named puppet stage inside a larger organisation and therefore a stage. Two is a floor and the Danish case is thin on candidates rather than on evidence. The reference article on Danish puppetry describes a field where performances are often given in private homes as a pastime while others try to professionalise, and names no company holding a hall. Denmark's professional figure theatre — Sofie Krog, Gruppe 38 and the rest — tours, and touring companies are outside the denominator by construction. What has not been done is a reading of Dansk UNIMA's own membership list, which is what corrected Sweden the same day and would be the first thing to open here.

observations.reasoning: Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. No establishment retained. The Danish National School of Performing Arts, the country's main public higher education institution for the performing arts, trains in dance, musical theatre and drama, with no puppetry stream. The Danish trainings identified in the field belong to another register: Thy Teater ran a two-year foundation course for puppet builders between 1996 and 2000, now defunct, and the Viborg college, Thisted branch, has run an animation course since 2004 which cooperates with Thy Teater without being a puppeteer training. Neither satisfies the denominator. Upper bound raised from 0 to 1. Estimate, resting on search summaries.

DISPUTED. First value produced as a mean conditioned on artists who actually tour, which drops from the denominator the makers who do not perform. Method error identified: a fee is not a performance. For France the true median probably sits between 10 and 20, over a bimodal distribution. For countries with permanent companies, recomputed from the top: 250 to 400 performances a year, casts of 3 to 5, a company of about twenty, so on the order of 50 to 90.
